notes.text: First test build of GodotHub Beta, the Flutter rewrite of GodotHub. It installs next to the stable app and starts from a copy of its data.
Window, title bar, theme, fonts, icons, animations and all 9 languages are in place. Most screens are not ported yet.

known_issues: Most views from the stable app are still missing.

notes.text: Projects View Screen
Versions View Screen
Remaining Views
Git Sidebar
UI Bugs
Smooth scrolling across views
In-app updater: downloads, verifies and applies updates by itself, with no external installer
Update log that lists every file as it is downloaded and installed
Restart to Apply Update button in the sidebar when an update is downloaded but the app has not restarted yet
Automatic rollback to the previous version if an update fails to start
Remaining integrations: Opener, Git, Discord etc.
Redesigned Check for Updates window
Faster startup on Windows
Smoother scrolling and dragging, with no stutter the first time an effect is drawn
Uses less memory than the stable app
Remaining differences from the stable app
Removed the card tilt effect
Tauri UI Preferences import to flutter
Windows accessibility and keyboard input
Tested Real updates end to end

Diagnostics log on your computer: errors, crashes and failed updates are written to a small log in the data folder, with tokens, passwords, emails and paths outside your projects removed. It never leaves your computer unless you send a bug report
"GodotHub closed unexpectedly" notice on the next start after a crash on Windows, with a button that opens a bug report already filled in
Bug reports include the last lines of the diagnostics log, shown to you before you send anything
High contrast colors while Windows high contrast is turned on
Project folders with very long paths now work on Windows
Linux: closing the window with Minimize to tray on no longer hides GodotHub on desktops that have no tray
macOS: updating a copy opened from Downloads now tells you to move GodotHub to Applications instead of failing
Windows: updates no longer unpack into the system Temp folder, and the launcher carries the same version info and publisher as the app, so antivirus tools are less likely to flag them
Final beta: once GodotHub 1.6.0 (the Flutter app) is out as the regular GodotHub, the beta shows a notice with a link to download it and, on Windows, a button to uninstall the beta
The beta ends with this release. Your beta projects and settings stay in the beta's own folder; GodotHub keeps using its existing data

known_issues: GodotHub Beta gets no further updates after this release.
